task: Build a frontend dashboard for the Claude Memory MCP server. Browse sessions, search memory, view conversations, see stats.

answers.design: Dark dev-tool — Linear/Vercel/Raycast aesthetic, dark bg, sharp typography, subtle borders, command palette
answers.deploy: Vercel — free tier, auto-deploy, serverless proxy hides API key
answers.stack: Vite + React 19 + shadcn/ui (Nova preset) + TypeScript 6 + Tailwind CSS 4
answers.chatView: Document/transcript — role labels, timestamps, markdown rendered, tool calls collapsed
answers.auth: Bearer token, proxied through Vercel serverless function (never exposed to browser)
answers.scope: Frontend only — backend already exists at https://owen-claude-memory.fly.dev
answers.features: Session list (grouped by date), full-text search (Cmd+K), conversation viewer, stats dashboard
answers.mobileSupport: Responsive — sidebar becomes drawer on mobile
